rulings.restated: Enter the amount from helper "Deduction before income limits for this item or group of similar items across all donees, after required valuation/basis reductions".
rulings.model: Its Section B refusal inherits that overbroad classification; the IRS excepts vehicles, intellectual property, inventory, and certain other securities reportable in Section A, not just publicly traded securities.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; accepted over-refusal. f8283 Section B covers "Donated Property Over $5,000 (Except Publicly Traded Securities, Vehicles, Intellectual Property or Inventory Reportable in Section A)". The project sends every over-$5,000 group except publicly traded securities to the Section B refusal, so a vehicle, intellectual property, inventory or certain other securities over $5,000 are refused rather than computed. That refuses returns the tool could support; it never computes a wrong amount.

rulings.model: The IRS Section B exclusion is broader: 'Donated Property Over $5,000 (Except Publicly Traded Securities, Vehicles, Intellectual Property or Inventory Reportable in Section A),' and Section A also includes certain other securities even over $5,000. The helper excludes only publicly traded securities.
